meta.bootstrap: 10000 resamples of leaves, percentile 95% CI, default_rng(20260928) re-seeded per disease, one index matrix per disease shared by all methods
meta.evaluation_space: 1024 x 1024 aspect-preserving letterbox (run_inference.py load()); leaf = alpha > 8; lesion = mask > 127 AND leaf
meta.leaf_rules: rust: abaxial face; leaf spot: mean of the two faces
meta.severity_denominator: full reference leaf area (unchanged by erosion/exclusion)
meta.erosion: lesion predictions allowed only where taxicab distance to background > e (= scipy binary_erosion, 3x3 cross, e iterations; verified on 12 images)
meta.tuning_set: validation diseased leaves only (rust 21, leaf spot 55); selection = max validation mean leaf IoU over threshold x erosion x exclusion; ties -> smaller erosion, then earlier exclusion option
meta.healthy_coverage: 21 healthy rust-pack TEST leaves present locally (EARTH); the other 33 of the paper's 54 were not retained. 21 healthy VALIDATION leaves (EARTH) reported as secondary.
